emerging_technology: Text-to-image diffusion models, with latent diffusion as the historical reference architecture; evaluate adjacent image editing/generation approaches as competitors, not as interchangeable diffusion models.
intended_application: Disposable INTERNAL campaign concept images and mood boards for homeware advertising; existing human review, manual/design agency work and independently checked final product photographs remain.
organization: Hypothetical U.S. homeware retailer with nine marketers/creatives, an assigned creative operations lead, a stocked product-photo repository, an approved software evaluation budget and security/procurement review; the trial itself is not yet authorized.
industry_sector: U.S. consumer homeware e-commerce and digital marketing.
business_need: Map image-generation and reference-based editing alternatives against manual or freelance concept development; identify what changes the decision to prepare a bounded comparison rather than immediately launch it.
users_stakeholders: Two marketers, owner, freelance designer, catalog content owners, downstream customers exposed only to approved final assets.
capabilities_constraints: Nine staff and designated operations lead, photo catalog, software budget, established creative and review workflow, but no measured matched-task comparison; current model/provider data terms and actual integration cost remain unverified.
risk_consequence_context: Concept boards can be discarded. Errors in reference-faithfulness, terms/rights, privacy, displaced work and downstream misuse remain relevant; no automatic public image publishing.
management_question: For internal boards, how should a better-resourced organization rank integration, vendor portability, privacy/rights and workflow-cost comparisons against the same market evidence?
time_horizon: Six-week management evidence review from 13 November 2026; vendor rights/terms checked just before any separately authorized trial.
additional_context: CONTRAST 2: same technology and same disposable internal concept-board use; different organization capacity and procurement pathway. Do not infer that staff/budget alone prove value, permissions or execution authorization.
